mentions.name: Concourse generative AI experiment pipelines
mentions.description: This project applies Concourse CI pipelines to generative AI experimentation, aiming at a more rigorous experimental approach across many odd techniques, configurations, LoRAs, and utilities, which have grown into dozens of experiment pipelines.
mentions.problem: The experiment pipelines have exploded into the dozens, and Concourse is not a large enough or high-level enough organizing principle for them.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got back into Concourse in order to attempt a more rigorous approach to generative AI experimentation as well. Unfortunately, there are just so many odd techniques, configurations, loras, and utilities striking my fancy that my experiment pipelines have exploded into the dozens, and Concourse is not a large enough or a high-level enough organizing principle.
